facts.text: Session is an MHO98 instrument session; production sessions open it lazily on first I/O
A Session accepts an identity only when its second comma-separated field is MHO98
idn() sends *IDN? and refuses an identity that is not MHO98, closing the transport
query() runs exactly the requested text query; write() sends one command without a readback
binary_query() returns one validated IEEE-488.2 definite-length payload, and write_binary() uploads one bounded binary block
is_healthy is false after a transport fault or close
query_error() drains :SYSTem:ERRor? and returns the first non-zero response
The waveform selector accepts CHAN1-CHAN4 and MATH1-MATH4, modes NORM/MAX/RAW and formats WORD/BYTE/ASC
The waveform module declares ceilings of 1000 NORM points, 500000000 memory points and 100000 inline points
get_waveform defaults to source CH1, start 1, 1000 points, mode NORM and format ASC
The waveform preamble has ten comma-separated fields and is rejected unless it has exactly ten
The waveform preamble format code must match the transfer format: BYTE 0, WORD 1, ASC 2
BYTE samples convert as (sample - yorigin - yreference) * yincrement
Waveform times are xorigin + (start - 1 + index - xreference) * xincrement
The pinned cursor state reads :CURSor:MODE? and the manual cursor A/B X screen positions with :CURSor:MANual:CAX? and :CURSor:MANual:CBX?
set_cursor sends :CURSor:MODE, :CURSor:MANual:TYPE, :CURSor:MANual:SOURce and the CAX/CBX positions for explicitly requested manual fields
The main timebase scale is read with :TIMebase:MAIN:SCALe? and written as :TIMebase:MAIN:SCALe
The main timebase scale must be positive; the clone states no maximum
CH1 scale and offset are read with :CHANnel1:SCALe? and :CHANnel1:OFFSet? and written under the same prefix
The channel scale bound depends on the input impedance and the probe ratio, which this driver does not read, so the clone does not state one fixed range
acquisition_control maps RUN to :RUN, STOP to :STOP, SINGLE to :SINGle and FORCE to :TFORce
The upstream scope stop helper writes :STOP, rejects a queued SCPI error and reads :TRIGger:STATus?
The main-offset validator treats trigger status STOP as the stopped case
Acquisition averages are 2 through 65536 and must be a power of two
Reference waveform slots are 1 through 10
Search event requests are limited to 1000 events
The upstream README prints the MHO98 identity as RIGOL TECHNOLOGIES,MHO98,MHO9A274501253,...

operator_required.name: timebase_scale_s_div
operator_required.reason: the clone validates only that the value is finite (and positive for a scale) but states no instrument range (timebase.py:175, channel.py:177-183, cursor.py:298); the site supplies the bound

operator_required.name: timebase_offset_s
operator_required.reason: the clone validates only that the value is finite (and positive for a scale) but states no instrument range (timebase.py:175, channel.py:177-183, cursor.py:298); the site supplies the bound

operator_required.name: ch1_scale_v_div
operator_required.reason: the clone derives the channel scale bound from the input impedance and the probe ratio (channel.py:160-175), which this driver does not read; the site supplies the range for its probe

operator_required.name: ch1_offset_v
operator_required.reason: the clone enforces no numeric channel offset range and leaves it to the instrument (channel.py:177-183); the site supplies the range for its probe
